daas-irab:34-37.t:
﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating. ﴿يَنْفَعُكُمْ نُصْحِي﴾ an imperfect verb, its fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its postponed fāʿil (agent); the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿أَرَدْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿أَنْ أَنْصَحَ﴾ an makes the verb accusative, and an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنصح, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ﴾ kāna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and the clause is initial. ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿إِنْ﴾ accusative-governing [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿إِنْ﴾ here; the word in the verse is أَنْ]. ﴿يُغْوِيَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative, its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi of يريد. ﴿هُوَ رَبُّكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ترجعون. ﴿تُرْجَعُونَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is maʿṭūf.

﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿افْتَراهُ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِ﴾ conditional. ﴿افْتَرَيْتُهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its clause is initial. ﴿فَعَلَيَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿إِجْرامِي﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied by the fitting vowel; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَأَنَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and أنا is mubtadaʾ. ﴿بَرِيءٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ composed of the preposition and the relative mā; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجرمون. ﴿تُجْرِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

﴿وَأُوحِيَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿إِلى نُوحٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أوحي. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ anna and its noun, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil of أوحي. ﴿لَنْ يُؤْمِنَ﴾ lan is an accusative-governing particle, and an imperfect verb in the accusative, and the clause is the khabar of anna. ﴿مِنْ قَوْمِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يؤمن, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, the fāʿil of يؤمن, and the clause is the khabar of أنه [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنْ﴾; the word in the verse is مَنْ]. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿آمَنَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَبْتَئِسْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿بِما﴾ relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تبتئس. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar.

﴿وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿بِأَعْيُنِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَوَحْيِنا﴾ conjoined to أعيننا. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تُخاطِبْنِي﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فِي الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is genitive by fī; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تخاطبني. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّهُمْ مُغْرَقُونَ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:38-40.t:
﴿وَيَصْنَعُ الْفُلْكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَكُلَّما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and kullamā is an adverb of time containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) سخروا. ﴿مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ مَلَأٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the prepositions with their genitive nouns are attached to مر, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿سَخِرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سخروا, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ تَسْخَرُوا﴾ in is conditional, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause is initial. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تسخروا. ﴿فَإِنَّا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and inna and its noun, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿نَسْخَرُ﴾ an imperfect verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنا. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نسخر. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is relative, in the position of the genitive; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نسخر. ﴿تَسْخَرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

﴿فَسَوْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; sawfa is for the future. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿مَنْ﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَأْتِيهِ عَذابٌ﴾ an imperfect verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿يُخْزِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب. ﴿وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذابٌ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يحل. ﴿مُقِيمٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to قلنا. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَفارَ التَّنُّورُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿قُلْنَا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿احْمِلْ﴾ an imperative verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to احمل. ﴿مِنْ كُلٍّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿زَوْجَيْنِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is dual. ﴿اثْنَيْنِ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is dual [Translator's note: the source says "genitive"; as tawkīd of the accusative زوجين one would expect "accusative"]. ﴿وَأَهْلَكَ﴾ conjoined to زوجين, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, excepted (mustathnā) by illā, in the position of the accusative [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنْ﴾; the word in the verse is مَنْ]. ﴿سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَوْلُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to سبق, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to أهلك. ﴿آمَنَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿آمَنَ مَعَهُ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent [Translator's note: so in the source; the fāʿil is in fact the overt قليل, as the source itself states below], and the adverb is attached to it, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿قَلِيلٌ﴾ fāʿil.

daas-irab:41-43.t:
﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ارْكَبُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) اركبوا. ﴿بِسْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مَجْراها﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَمُرْساها﴾ conjoined to مجراها. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two khabars, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive.

﴿وَهِيَ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl (circumstance) and هي is mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجري. ﴿فِي مَوْجٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تجري. ﴿كَالْجِبالِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of موج. ﴿وَنادى﴾ a past verb. ﴿نُوحٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿ابْنَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَكانَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and kāna, its noun omitted. ﴿فِي مَعْزِلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿بُنَيَّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), the yāʾ of the speaker having been dropped for lightness, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿ارْكَبْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿مَعَنا﴾ an adverb of place attached to اركب, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm), its noun omitted [Translator's note: so in the source; the noun is usually taken as a latent pronoun]. ﴿مَعَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined).

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَآوِي﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِلى جَبَلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سآوي. ﴿يَعْصِمُنِي﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is an adjective of جبل. ﴿مِنَ الْماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يعصمني. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ the lā of generic negation, operating like inna. ﴿عاصِمَ﴾ its noun. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative by exception [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنَ﴾; the word in the verse is مَنْ]. ﴿رَحِمَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَحالَ بَيْنَهُمَا الْمَوْجُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil; بينهما is an adverb of place attached to حال, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فَكانَ مِنَ الْمُغْرَقِينَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and kāna, its noun omitted, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:44-46.t:
﴿وَقِيلَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَرْضُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ابْلَعِي﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is fāʿil (agent). ﴿ماءَكِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the vocative clause and the imperative clause are in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿وَيا سَماءُ﴾ conjoined to يا أرض. ﴿أَقْلِعِي﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَغِيضَ الْماءُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes, and parsed like it. ﴿وَاسْتَوَتْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) استوت. ﴿وَقِيلَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil latent. ﴿بُعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "بعد بعدا". ﴿لِلْقَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعدا. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ an adjective, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

﴿وَنادى﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿نُوحٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is explicative. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed, with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which was dropped for lightness, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّ ابْنِي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ الْحَقُّ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَنْتَ أَحْكَمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿الْحاكِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿نُوحُ﴾ the one addressed, a singular proper name, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun omitted. ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿عَمَلٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿صالِحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَسْئَلْنِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the dropped yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective past verb. ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to علم. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾ the noun of laysa, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna, and the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿أَعِظُكَ﴾ a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; أعظ is an imperfect verb] and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿تَكُونَ﴾ a defective imperfect verb, its noun omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْجاهِلِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition.

daas-irab:47-49.t:
﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which was dropped for lightness, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَعُوذُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إني. ﴿بِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعوذ. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿أَسْئَلَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative; the kāf is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and its fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it are accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿ما﴾ relative, second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to علم. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾ the noun of laysa, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَإِلَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive and in is conditional, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَغْفِرْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is initial. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تغفر. ﴿وَتَرْحَمْنِي﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَكُنْ﴾ a defective imperfect verb in the jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); its clause has no grammatical position because it is not joined to the fāʾ; its noun is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْخاسِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar.

﴿قِيلَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿نُوحُ﴾ the one addressed, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative, and its clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿اهْبِطْ﴾ an imperative verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿بِسَلامٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سلام. ﴿وَبَرَكاتٍ﴾ conjoined to سلام. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بركات. ﴿وَعَلى أُمَمٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِمَّنْ﴾ min is a preposition and man is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أمم. ﴿مَعَكَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَأُمَمٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and أمم is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يمسهم. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ an adjective.

﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿مِنْ أَنْباءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نُوحِيها﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نوحيها. ﴿ما كُنْتَ﴾ mā is negating, and kāna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَعْلَمُها﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis). ﴿وَلا قَوْمُكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, lā is redundant (zāʾida), and قومك is conjoined to the fāʿil of تعلمها. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative and muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَاصْبِرْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ الْعاقِبَةَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:50-52.t:
﴿وَإِلى عادٍ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أرسلنا". ﴿أَخاهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the alif because it is one of the five nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هُوداً﴾ badal (substitute) of أخاهم. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ, which was dropped for lightness. ﴿اعْبُدُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi; the vocative clause and what follows it are the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾ genitive in form, nominative in position, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿غَيْرُهُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) following the position. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مُفْتَرُونَ﴾ khabar, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl.

﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ its parsing has just preceded. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿أَسْئَلُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أسألكم. ﴿أَجْراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle of negation. ﴿أَجْرِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿عَلَى الَّذِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿فَطَرَنِي﴾ a past verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, lā is negating and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined).

﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes, and parsed like it. ﴿اسْتَغْفِرُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ تُوبُوا﴾ conjoined to استغفروا. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to توبوا. ﴿يُرْسِلِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), with a latent fāʿil. ﴿السَّماءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يرسل. ﴿مِدْراراً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَزِدْكُمْ﴾ conjoined to يرسل, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلى قُوَّتِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَتَوَلَّوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿مُجْرِمِينَ﴾ ḥāl, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:53-55.t:
﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿هُودُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿جِئْتَنا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿بِبَيِّنَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) جئتنا. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ its noun. ﴿بِتارِكِي﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and تاركي is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā. ﴿آلِهَتِنا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَنْ قَوْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تاركي. ﴿وَما نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ its parsing is like that of the preceding one.

﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle of negation. ﴿نَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿اعْتَراكَ﴾ a past verb and its fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَعْضُ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿آلِهَتِنا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿بِسُوءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اعتراك. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أُشْهِدُ اللَّهَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar of إني, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent [Translator's note: so in the source; أُشهِدُ is an active imperfect verb whose fāʿil is a latent "I", with the Name of Majesty as its mafʿūl bihi]. ﴿وَاشْهَدُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أَنِّي بَرِيءٌ﴾ anna, its noun and its khabar, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of اشهدوا. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ min is a preposition and mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بريء. ﴿تُشْرِكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَكِيدُونِي﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿تُنْظِرُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā; the wāw is fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ, dropped for lightness, is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:56-57.t:
﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَوَكَّلْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by ʿalā; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) توكلت. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ badal (substitute), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَرَبِّكُمْ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿مِنْ دَابَّةٍ﴾ min is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and دابة is mubtadaʾ (subject), genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿هُوَ آخِذٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is the khabar of دابة. ﴿بِناصِيَتِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آخذ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى صِراطٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and in is conditional. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is initial, and the clause "in …" etc. is resumptive. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَبْلَغْتُكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أُرْسِلْتُ﴾ a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلت, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ fāʿil, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, its appearance prevented by the fitting vowel, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿غَيْرَكُمْ﴾ an adjective, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is negating. ﴿تَضُرُّونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative; the wāw is fāʿil and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; ضرّ does not normally take two objects, and شيئا is often parsed as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object)]. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حفيظ. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَفِيظٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl).

daas-irab:58-60.t:
﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and lammā al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time and a non-jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَجَّيْنا هُوداً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to هودا. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنوا, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نجينا. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of رحمة. ﴿وَنَجَّيْناهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مِنْ عَذابٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نجيناهم. ﴿غَلِيظٍ﴾ an adjective.

﴿وَتِلْكَ عادٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and تلك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address, and عاد is khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَحَدُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is an adjective of عاد or a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جحدوا. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعَصَوْا رُسُلَهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَبَّارٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَنِيدٍ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَأُتْبِعُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is genitive by fī; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتبعوا. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ badal (substitute) of the demonstrative, genitive (majrūr) with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿لَعْنَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to the omitted verb أتبعوا. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention. ﴿إِنَّ عاداً﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the khabar of inna. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of drawing attention and of opening (istiftāḥ). ﴿بُعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "بعدوا بعدا". ﴿لِعادٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعدا. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ badal of عاد. ﴿هُودٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:61-62.t:
﴿وَإِلى ثَمُودَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أرسلنا", and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أَخاهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the omitted verb, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿صالِحاً﴾ badal (substitute) of أخاهم. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) omitted [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book calls this fāʿil latent (mustatir)], and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ yā is a vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, which was dropped for lightness. ﴿اعْبُدُوا﴾ an imperative verb, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما لَكُمْ﴾ mā is negating; لكم, a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿إِلهٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿غَيْرُهُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of إله following the position, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَنْشَأَكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of هو. ﴿مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنشأكم. ﴿وَاسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ﴾ conjoined to أنشأكم. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استعمركم. ﴿فَاسْتَغْفِرُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿ثُمَّ تُوبُوا﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to توبوا. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and قريب and مجيب are its two khabars, and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿صالِحُ﴾ the one addressed, a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿فِينا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مرجوا. ﴿مَرْجُوًّا﴾ khabar; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to مرجوا. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَتَنْهانا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿نَعْبُدَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative whose fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَعْبُدُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿آباؤُنا﴾ fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَإِنَّنا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَفِي شَكٍّ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ min is a preposition and mā is a relative noun; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شك. ﴿تَدْعُونا﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تدعونا. ﴿مُرِيبٍ﴾ an adjective of شك.

daas-irab:63-64.t:
﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is initial. ﴿عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of بينة, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَآتانِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آتاني. ﴿رَحْمَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and man is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿يَنْصُرُنِي﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); the nūn is for protection, the yāʾ is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar of man. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by min; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينصرني. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿عَصَيْتُهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is initial, and its apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿تَزِيدُونَنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَخْسِيرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ its parsing has preceded. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿ناقَةُ﴾ khabar. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿آيَةً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿فَذَرُوها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿تَأْكُلْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab). ﴿فِي أَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأكل. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَمَسُّوها﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive by the dropping of the nūn, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِسُوءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تمسوها, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذابٌ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied an after the fāʾ of causation; the kāf is its fronted mafʿūl bihi and عذاب its postponed fāʿil. ﴿قَرِيبٌ﴾ an adjective of عذاب.

daas-irab:65-67.t:
﴿فَعَقَرُوها﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقالَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿تَمَتَّعُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿فِي دارِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تمتعوا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثَلاثَةَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to تمتعوا. ﴿أَيَّامٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿وَعْدٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of وعد. ﴿مَكْذُوبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive.

﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and lammā al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time attached to جاء [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book attaches lammā to its apodosis (here نجينا), since the clause after it is its muḍāf ilayhi]. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَجَّيْنا صالِحاً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the apodosis of lammā, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is conjoined to صالحا. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to آمنوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of رحمة. ﴿وَمِنْ خِزْيِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "نجيناكم من خزي". ﴿يَوْمِئِذٍ﴾ يوم is muḍāf ilayhi, and idh is an adverb containing the sense of condition, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْقَوِيُّ﴾ the first khabar of inna. ﴿الْعَزِيزُ﴾ a second khabar.

﴿وَأَخَذَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and aṣbaḥa and its noun. ﴿فِي دِيارِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاثمين, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جاثِمِينَ﴾ the khabar of أصبحوا, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:68-70.t:
﴿كَأَنْ﴾ lightened from kaʾanna; its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a particle of negation, of the jussive and of conversion (qalb) [i.e. of the imperfect to past meaning]. ﴿يَغْنَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يغنوا, and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of kaʾan. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿إِنَّ ثَمُودَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿كَفَرُوا رَبَّهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of opening and drawing attention. ﴿بُعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "بعدوا بعدا". ﴿لِثَمُودَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعدا, and ثمود is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote.

﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive, and the lām occurs in the answer to the omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَتْ رُسُلُنا إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the tāʾ is for the feminine and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause occurs as the answer to the oath. ﴿بِالْبُشْرى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاءت. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb) [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause قالوا is more naturally resumptive, and it is سلاما that is the object of the speech]. ﴿سَلاماً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَلامٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), its khabar omitted, its implied form being "عليكم", and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿فَما لَبِثَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, mā is negating, and a past verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing, and ﴿جاءَ﴾ a past verb; an and what follows it are in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of لبث. ﴿بِعِجْلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاء. ﴿حَنِيذٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and lammā al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time. ﴿رَأى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَيْدِيَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَصِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تصل, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَكِرَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿وَأَوْجَسَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿خِيفَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا تَخَفْ﴾ lā is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb in the jussive, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أُرْسِلْنا﴾ a passive past verb, and nā is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿إِلى قَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلنا. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:71-73.t:
﴿وَامْرَأَتُهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قائِمَةٌ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَضَحِكَتْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَبَشَّرْناها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿بِإِسْحاقَ﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition, and إسحاق is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) بشرناها. ﴿وَمِنْ وَراءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿إِسْحاقَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿يَعْقُوبَ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ; in the reading with the accusative it is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb; and the clause is maʿṭūf.

﴿قالَتْ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿وَيْلَتى﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, and the yāʾ of the speaker has been turned into an alif. ﴿أَأَلِدُ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿وَأَنَا عَجُوزٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهذا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿بَعْلِي﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied by the fitting vowel. ﴿شَيْخاً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ هذا﴾ inna, and the demonstrative is its noun. ﴿لَشَيْءٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and شيء is khabar. ﴿عَجِيبٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is resumptive.

﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَتَعْجَبِينَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the yāʾ is fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿مِنْ أَمْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تعجبين. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَحْمَتُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَرَكاتُهُ﴾ conjoined to رحمة, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿أَهْلَ﴾ the one addressed, accusative (manṣūb), with the vocative particle يا omitted. ﴿الْبَيْتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two khabars, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:74-77.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and lammā al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time. ﴿ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْراهِيمَ الرَّوْعُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذهب, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَجاءَتْهُ الْبُشْرى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its postponed fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿يُجادِلُنا﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي قَوْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يجادلنا. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّاهٌ مُنِيبٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and what follows it are khabars (predicates) of inna.

﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿إِبْراهِيمُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿أَعْرِضْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَنْ هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh) and ذا is a demonstrative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعرض. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِنَّهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and inna and its noun. ﴿آتِيهِمْ﴾ khabar, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ fāʿil of آتيهم. ﴿غَيْرُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب. ﴿مَرْدُودٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.

﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and lammā al-ḥīniyya is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَتْ رُسُلُنا لُوطاً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سِيءَ﴾ a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سيء, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of lammā. ﴿وَضاقَ بِهِمْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the statement is conjoined to سيء بهم. ﴿ذَرْعاً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿هذا يَوْمٌ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention, and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and يوم is its khabar. ﴿عَصِيبٌ﴾ an adjective, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb).

daas-irab:78-80.t:
﴿وَجاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, its fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its postponed fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُهْرَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), min is a preposition, and قبل is an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يعملون. ﴿كانُوا﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; given the circumstantial wāw, the clause is presumably meant to be a ḥāl]. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئاتِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the wāw is fāʿil, and السيئات is mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural, and the clause is the khabar (predicate).

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿هؤُلاءِ بَناتِي﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject), and بناتي is khabar, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is a second khabar. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أطهر. ﴿فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تُخْزُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lā; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فِي ضَيْفِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تخزوني. ﴿أَلَيْسَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and laysa is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿رَجُلٌ﴾ the noun of laysa. ﴿رَشِيدٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is resumptive.

﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿عَلِمْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿لَنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿فِي بَناتِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿حَقٍّ﴾ mubtadaʾ, genitive in form and nominative in position, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَإِنَّكَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and inna and its noun, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَتَعْلَمُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَوْ﴾ a particle containing the sense of condition, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar of anna. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ḥāl. ﴿قُوَّةً﴾ the noun of anna; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being "ثبت", and the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿آوِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿إِلى رُكْنٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آوي. ﴿شَدِيدٍ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:81-83.t:
﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿لُوطُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative. ﴿إِنَّا رُسُلُ﴾ inna and its noun [and its khabar (predicate)]; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَنْ يَصِلُوا﴾ lan is accusative-governing, and an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصلوا. ﴿فَأَسْرِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِأَهْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أسر, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِقِطْعٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنَ اللَّيْلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of قطع. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿يَلْتَفِتْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يلتفت. ﴿أَحَدٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿امْرَأَتَكَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by illā, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مُصِيبُها﴾ a fronted khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the khabar of إنه. ﴿أَصابَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ الصُّبْحُ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَيْسَ الصُّبْحُ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and laysa is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and الصبح is its noun. ﴿بِقَرِيبٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and قريب is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position.

﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and lammā al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جَعَلْنا عالِيَها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of lammā. ﴿سافِلَها﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَمْطَرْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أمطرنا. ﴿حِجارَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an adjective of حجارة. ﴿مَنْضُودٍ﴾ a second adjective of حجارة, and the clause is maʿṭūf [Translator's note: so in the source; منضود is genitive and is usually taken as an adjective of سجيل]. ﴿مُسَوَّمَةً﴾ an adjective of حجارة. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to مسومة. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿هِيَ﴾ the noun of mā. ﴿مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعيد. ﴿بِبَعِيدٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and بعيد, genitive in form and accusative in position, is its khabar, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:84-85.t:
﴿وَإِلى مَدْيَنَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "أرسلنا إلى مدين". ﴿أَخاهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿شُعَيْباً﴾ badal (substitute). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ yā is a vocative particle, and قوم is accusative by the vocative, the sign of its accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ما لَكُمْ مِنْ إِلهٍ﴾ mā operates like laysa; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the fronted khabar (predicate); min is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and إله is its noun, genitive in form and nominative in position. ﴿غَيْرُهُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of إله, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَنْقُصُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿الْمِكْيالَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْمِيزانَ﴾ conjoined to المكيال, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿أَراكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِخَيْرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أراكم. ﴿وَإِنِّي أَخافُ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخاف. ﴿عَذابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُحِيطٍ﴾ an adjective.

﴿وَيا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and yā is a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿أَوْفُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْمِكْيالَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْمِيزانَ﴾ conjoined to المكيال. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَبْخَسُوا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive by the dropping of the nūn. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَشْياءَهُمْ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلا تَعْثَوْا﴾ conjoined to ولا تبخسوا. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to لا تعثوا. ﴿مُفْسِدِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:86-88.t:
﴿بَقِيَّتُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is initial. ﴿مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ khabar, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَنَا﴾ its noun. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حفيظ. ﴿بِحَفِيظٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and حفيظ is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position.

﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿شُعَيْبُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative. ﴿أَصَلاتُكَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and صلاتك is mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَأْمُرُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿نَتْرُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) with a latent fāʿil; an and what follows it are accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿ما﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَعْبُدُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿آباؤُنا﴾ fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿نَفْعَلَ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فِي أَمْوالِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نفعل, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَشؤُا﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿لَأَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the khabar of إنك. ﴿الرَّشِيدُ﴾ a second khabar.

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ its parsing has just preceded. ﴿أَرَأَيْتُمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بينة, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَرَزَقَنِي﴾ a past verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to رزقني. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَسَناً﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿أُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative with a latent fāʿil. ﴿إِنْ﴾ accusative-governing [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿إِنْ﴾; the word in the verse is أَنْ]. ﴿أُخالِفَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative; the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the mafʿūl bihi of أريد. ﴿إِلى ما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخالفكم. ﴿أَنْهاكُمْ﴾ a past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; أنهى is an imperfect verb], and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنهاكم, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle of negation. ﴿أُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْإِصْلاحَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (infinitival). ﴿اسْتَطَعْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; mā and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿تَوْفِيقِي﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to توكلت, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أنيب. ﴿أُنِيبُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

daas-irab:89-92.t:
﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, yā is a vocative particle, and قوم is the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive. ﴿يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شِقاقِي﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿يُصِيبَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative, and the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi; an and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of يجرمنكم. ﴿مِثْلُ﴾ fāʿil, nominative. ﴿ما﴾ relative, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَصابَ﴾ a past verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نُوحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صالِحٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ its noun. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) بعيد. ﴿بِبَعِيدٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and بعيد is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, the khabar (predicate) of mā, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تُوبُوا﴾ conjoined to استغفروا. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to توبوا. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ﴾ the two khabars of inna, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position.

﴿قالُوا﴾ an imperative verb [Translator's note: so in the source; قالوا is a past verb] and its fāʿil. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿شُعَيْبُ﴾ the one addressed, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿نَفْقَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative with a latent fāʿil. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نفقه. ﴿تَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and inna and its noun, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَنَراكَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the kāf is its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿فِينا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ضعيفا. ﴿ضَعِيفاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; if نرى is visual, ضعيفا is a ḥāl; if it is of knowledge, it is the second mafʿūl bihi]. ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and lawlā is a particle of non-occurrence owing to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd). ﴿رَهْطُكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the khabar is omitted, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَرَجَمْناكَ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer of lawlā, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ its noun. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عزيز. ﴿بِعَزِيزٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant preposition, and عزيز is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed, accusative, the sign of its accusative being an implied fatḥa on the letter before the dropped yāʾ of the speaker. ﴿أَرَهْطِي﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and رهطي is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَعَزُّ﴾ khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعز. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by min; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعز. ﴿وَاتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ﴾ the wāw is the wāw of ḥāl, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَراءَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to اتخذتموه, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ظِهْرِيًّا﴾ ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is a causal explanation. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to محيط. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مُحِيطٌ﴾ the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:93-96.t:
﴿وَيا قَوْمِ﴾ its parsing has just preceded. ﴿اعْمَلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلى مَكانَتِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl). ﴿عامِلٌ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَوْفَ﴾ for deferment (taswīf). ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَأْتِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿يُخْزِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of عذاب. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and man is relative, conjoined to the first man. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كاذِبٌ﴾ khabar, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَارْتَقِبُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to رقيب, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿رَقِيبٌ﴾ khabar.

﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and lammā al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَجَّيْنا شُعَيْباً﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is conjoined to شعيبا. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to نجينا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِرَحْمَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of رحمة. ﴿وَأَخَذَتِ الَّذِينَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and a relative noun, fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الصَّيْحَةُ﴾ postponed fāʿil. ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and aṣbaḥa and its noun. ﴿فِي دِيارِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاثمين, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿جاثِمِينَ﴾ khabar. ﴿كَأَنْ﴾ lightened from kaʾanna, its noun omitted, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a jussive-governing particle. ﴿يَغْنَوْا﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of kaʾan. ﴿فِيها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يغنوا. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle of opening (istiftāḥ) and drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿بُعْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿لِمَدْيَنَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to بعدا. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is maṣdariyya (infinitival); mā and what follows it are in the position of the genitive, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an omitted adjective of بعد. ﴿بَعِدَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿ثَمُودُ﴾ the fāʿil of بعدت.

﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَرْسَلْنا مُوسى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلنا. ﴿وَسُلْطانٍ﴾ conjoined to آياتنا. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective.

daas-irab:97-100.t:
﴿إِلى فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ فرعون is a diptote, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا. ﴿وَمَلَائِهِ﴾ conjoined to فرعون, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ the noun of mā [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿أَمْرَ﴾ with fatḥa; as the noun of mā it is أَمْرُ, nominative]. ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿بِرَشِيدٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and رشيد is the khabar (predicate), genitive in form and accusative in position, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

﴿يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to يقدم. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil. ﴿النَّارَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَبِئْسَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb for expressing blame (inshāʾ al-dhamm). ﴿الْوِرْدُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الْمَوْرُودُ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَأُتْبِعُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي هذِهِ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا [Translator's note: so in the source; the demonstrative here is ذه] is in the position of the genitive by the preposition; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتبعوا. ﴿لَعْنَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَيَوْمَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and يوم is an adverb of time attached to أتبعوا. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِئْسَ﴾ a past verb for expressing blame. ﴿الرِّفْدُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الْمَرْفُودُ﴾ an adjective, and the clause is resumptive.

﴿ذلِكَ﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is for address. ﴿مِنْ أَنْباءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْقُرى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَقُصُّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is a second khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نقصه. ﴿مِنْها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿قائِمٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَحَصِيدٌ﴾ conjoined to قائم, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:101-105.t:
﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿ظَلَمْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and lākin is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَنْفُسَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction and mā is negating. ﴿أَغْنَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) أغنت. ﴿آلِهَتُهُمُ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa) of آلهتهم. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ al-ḥīniyya ("when"), an adverb of time. ﴿جاءَ أَمْرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive and mā is negating. ﴿زادُوهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَتْبِيبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive.
